releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.9.0 (Cell-Aware Inpainting & Precise Font Matching)
changelog:
✨ Table Cell-Aware Inpainting & Font Consensus Fixes:
• Boundary-Aware Table Inpainting: Inpainting now automatically detects table cell grid lines and notebook ruled borders, clamping background synthesis strictly inside cell borders so grid lines are never sliced or damaged.
• Full Border Reconstruction: Any crossing or adjacent grid lines are cleanly reconstructed across the full bounding span, eliminating broken line artifacts and fake colon marks.
• True Gray Table Cell Inpainting: Background sampling is constrained to the active table cell and will never cross horizontal borders into adjacent white rows, preserving authentic tinted/gray row backgrounds.
• Zero-Ghosting Solid Text Eradication: Target word bounding box is 100% solidly masked with 255 alpha to ensure zero remnants or double text, while smooth alpha feathering applies only to the outer margin.
• Exact Line-Dominant Font Matching: Replaced text strictly respects the dominant font of adjacent words on the same line, matching Arial double-story 'a' on invoice headers and preventing incorrect font fallbacks.
